Shorthand notes from calls and emails:
- Primary problem: legal + customer success need sub-300ms search for UK/EU users; many PII contracts; strict residency ask.
- Index profile: contracts (avg 2k tokens), KB articles, annotated precedents. Initial corpus ~8M docs but expecting 20–30M in 12 months.
- "two-stage" retrieval desired: inexpensive vector recall (ann/kNN) -> lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-50. Want reranker latency p95 < 100ms.
- Customer: "We need a predictable cost model — we can't have per-query spikes that double cost month-to-month." — CTO.
- Favored deployment: private control plane in EU with dedicated inference pool for reranking; fallback region in eu-west for failover.
- Security: must have SSO (SAML), KMS integration, audit logs retained 7+ years per legal ask; data residency proof for UK and EU.
- Model preferences: open embeddings (mpnet/all-MiniLM family) for cost; cross-encoder small/quantized models for rerank (distil/cross-encoder distilled). Will test Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: P@5 >= 0.7 on vendor-curated queries; end-to-end median latency < 200ms; cost projection <= €0.01/query at 10k QPS monthly profile.
- Procurement note: finance wants clear TCO comparison vs Elastic + in-house GPU cluster.
- Next internal ask: legal to sign narrow NDA and security questionnaire needs written EU-residency attestation (action: Marta to provide attestation template).
